source.title: Seth - Swift Shadow
source.name: Seth
source.description: A swift Assassin who is skilled at ambushing injured targets.

skills.name: Shadow Strike

description.raw: Seth flashes forward toward an enemy, dealing 100% (ATK-based) damage 3 times, then freezes them briefly and jumps to deal 150% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) more damage to the target. Seth becomes invincible and recovers HP equal to 25% of the total damage dealt during this skill. Seth prioritizes selecting the weakest enemy as the target.
active: Seth flashes forward toward an enemy, dealing 100% (ATK-based) damage 3 times, then freezes them briefly and jumps to deal 150% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) more damage to the target.
Seth becomes invincible and recovers HP equal to 25% of the total damage dealt during this skill.
Seth prioritizes selecting the weakest enemy as the target.

text: Increases HP recovery from each Bloodlust stack to 15% of the total damage dealt.

skills.description_lite: Seth flashes forward an enemy and deals multiple attacks.

skills.name: Predator's Lunge

description.raw: Seth pounces on the weakest enemy in range and deals 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage plus 25% of the target's lost HP. The additional damage cannot exceed 400% of his ATK.
active: Seth pounces on the weakest enemy in range and deals 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage plus 25% of the target's lost HP.
The additional damage cannot exceed 400% of his ATK.

skills.description_lite: Seth pounces on the weakest nearby enemy and deals damage.

skills.name: Hunter Instinct

description.raw: Seth gains stacks of Bloodlust when the HP of a non-summoned enemy first falls below 33%, up to 3 stacks. Each stack permanently increases his Haste by 10 + 1.5 (SP-based) and Life Drain by 7 + 1 (SP-based). Seth gains 25% Phys and Magic DEF when he first triggers Bloodlust.
active: Seth gains stacks of Bloodlust when the HP of a non-summoned enemy first falls below 33%, up to 3 stacks.
Each stack permanently increases his Haste by 10 + 1.5 (SP-based) and Life Drain by 7 + 1 (SP-based).
Seth gains 25% Phys and Magic DEF when he first triggers Bloodlust.

text: Gains a stack of Bloodlust when the HP of a non-summoned enemy first falls below 50%.
Increases Haste by 12 + 1.5 (SP-based) and Life Drain by 10 + 1 (SP-based) permanently with each stack of Bloodlust.
Gains 25 Crit when he first triggers Bloodlust.

skills.description_lite: Seth gains stat bonuses when an enemy's HP is too low.

skills.name: Hunting Spree

description.raw: Seth immediately resets the cooldown of Predator's Lunge and recovers 200 Energy when a non-summoned enemy is defeated.
active: Seth immediately resets the cooldown of Predator's Lunge and recovers 200 Energy when a non-summoned enemy is defeated.

text: Increases damage of Predator's Lunge by an extra 15% for each casting, up to 5 stacks.

skills.description_lite: Seth immediately resets the cooldown of Predator's Lunge and recovers some Energy when a non-summoned enemy is defeated.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Seth reduces the target's Phys DEF by an extra 15% for 6s per stack of Bloodlust if he already carries Bloodlust when casting Predator's Lunge.
active: Seth reduces the target's Phys DEF by an extra 15% for 6s per stack of Bloodlust if he already carries Bloodlust when casting Predator's Lunge.

skills.description_lite: Seth reduces the target's Phys DEF by an extra amount if he carries Bloodlust when casting Predator's Lunge.
